frozenFiles.note: 2026-09-14 #381-A: download streams the body into the destination file with a counted, bounded buffer and an optional display-only progress observer (default no-op; the two-argument call still compiles). Behavior change that also applies to legacy two-argument callers such as the desktop standalone updater: after the response headers, a body with no data for 2 minutes is aborted (retry the update), next to the existing 10-minute ceiling, and a non-2xx response no longer writes its error page into the destination. Default repo slug, mirror URL/env toggle, manifest parsing, asset names, User-Agent and SHA256SUMS verification remain unchanged. ReleaseClientDownloadTest covers known/unknown length, redirects, HTTP errors, truncated and stalled bodies, lying Content-Length, callback rate and observer exceptions against a local HTTP fixture.

2026-09-11 observability: add bounded upgrade diagnostics and a post-switch receipt; preserve CLI symlink resolution, asset names, checksums, install paths, version switching and service identity. 2026-09-14 #364: recognize Homebrew/Scoop layouts and emit their upgrade commands only on the matching host OS; a managed layout still takes priority and unrecognized layouts get the host installer one-liner. Stable asset names, checksum validation, install paths, service identity, executable names, package-manager package ids and legacy CLI commands remain unchanged. UpdateServiceTest covers host-scoped classification and cross-platform command rejection; reviewed third-batch change. 2026-09-14 #381-A: apply accepts an optional phase/download-progress listener (default quiet; listener exceptions are swallowed) rendered by the update CLI on stderr and kept silent for background auto-update. Asset names, checksum validation, temp-dir cleanup, install paths, version switching, service identity, executable names and legacy CLI commands remain unchanged. UpdateProgressTest covers terminal and redirected output plus checksum/HTTP failure without switching the launcher.

2026-09-11 observability: optional diagnostic context and connection IDs; capability defaults false. Existing wire names, identity and E2E payload semantics preserved; DiagnosticWireCompatTest covers older peers and malformed metadata. 2026-09-13 #376: append nullable SessionLive.notice with a null default; null is omitted and legacy clients ignore the optional informational field. Existing frame names, lifecycle fields, identity and E2E semantics remain unchanged. SessionNoticeWireCompatTest covers legacy decoding and null omission; independent wire review passed. 2026-09-14 #362: append trailing optional DaemonInfo.supportsProjectPins and ClientCaps.supportsProjectPins, both defaulting to false; project pin frames live in ProjectPins.kt and are never sent to a peer that did not advertise the capability. Existing identity, key derivation, frame names, default behavior and E2E semantics remain unchanged. ProjectPinsWireCompatTest covers absent-capability decoding both ways, unknown pin frames and unknown keys; independent additive wire review passed.
